_comment: What Oracle's intro card says in each space. Edit freely — this file is data, not code, and is re-read on each deploy. Keys under `spaces` are space display names, matched case-insensitively; a space with no entry gets `generic`. `can` lines go under "What I can do here" and should each name the command or wording that starts it. `examples` are copy-paste prompts, shown behind the card's own button and in a /help reply. `privately` and `goodToKnow` are the same everywhere except that a space Oracle keeps a copy of (data/chat/listen-spaces.json) also gets `listeningNote`. Loader: src/cards/intro-card.js
privately: DM me for anything you'd rather not ask in front of the team — a client's history, a draft, or "what did we decide about X?"
DM me "digest" for what's waiting on you, or "what can you do?" for the full list.
goodToKnow: In a space I only see messages where I'm @mentioned.
Before I change anything in HubSpot, a calendar or a Doc, I show you exactly what I'd do — anyone in the thread can reply "yes" to confirm.
I never contact a client. Drafts come back to you.
listeningNote: I keep a 12-month copy of this space's messages so I can answer questions about past discussions here. I still only reply when you @mention me.

can: Track who has the ball on a thread — reply /track in it.
Find a time for a call — /meet, with the people @mentioned.
Watch a funding program for changes — reply "@Oracle watch" to the post about it.
Answer questions about clients, grants, Drive files and past discussions.
examples: @Oracle what's the status of the Acme deal?
@Oracle summarise this thread into next steps
